subject: Request: Temporary per-token slope adjustment for Greenfield Analytics
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: aisha@greenfield.ai, procurement@greenfield.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenfield hosted API — proposal & ask for temporary slope

Aisha / Greenfield team — thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a formal commit proposal that aligns with your expected Q2-Q4 usage trajectory. The key ask from your side was a smoother per-token price decline across the first 6 months of the commit (you called it a "gentle slope") so short-term unit economics match the volume ramp while staying within our finance guardrails.

High-level summary in the attachment: a 12M commit structured as 3 tranches (months 1-3, 4-6, 7-12) with a temporary per-token slope that makes month 1 and month 2 prices ~15% below our published rate card for the highest volume band, then phase back to standard rate card pricing by month 7. The total committed spend still meets the minimum target we discussed.

Next steps: can you confirm the ramp assumptions in sheet "usage_model"? If so I'll route this internally for a short-term pricing exception approval (we typically need Sales + Finance + Ops signoff for slope deviations). I copied Karthik and Laura for approval path.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- Greenfield_Guide-to-Commit-Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, 4 pages)
- greenfield_commit_calc.xlsx (usage model, 3 sheets)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenfield hosted API — proposal & ask for temporary slope

Jonas — thanks for the packet. A few quick items finance will need before I can clear a slope exception:

- Clear expected billed monthly spend (not just committed) for months 1-6 and month 7+ (use the sheet, but please call out the numbers in the email).
- Confirmation that caching/batching config is locked for the first 90 days (we need to avoid them changing runtime config to game per-token price).
- Duration of the slope adjustment and a hard sunset date — we need automatic reversion to the rate card.
- Any downstream contract language required (if Legal needs a specific clause calling out the temporary price profile).

If you can reply with those bullets filled in we can move to an approval meeting. We can approve a single temporary slope for up to 6 months with Finance and a Partner Ops signoff; anything longer needs VP signoff.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Pricing & Revenue Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha@greenfield.ai, procurement@greenfield.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenfield hosted API — proposal & ask for temporary slope

Thanks Karthik — answers below (copied into the Greenfield thread so they have visibility):

- Expected billed spend (months 1-6): Month1 $120k, Month2 $180k, Month3 $260k, Month4 $420k, Month5 $520k, Month6 $610k. Month7+ normalized to average $850k/mo over remainder of year. (Numbers are expected billed take, not peak; see greenfield_commit_calc.xlsx usage_model sheet).
- Caching/batching locked: Greenfield has agreed (via conversation and noted in the proposal) to an "inference config freeze" for months 0-3 covering batching and prefix cache policies; changes require 30-day notice and written approval from Redwood.
- Duration & sunset: Temporary slope applies months 1-6; pricing auto-reverts to standard rate card pricing at the start of month 7. We propose explicit language in the SOW: "Temporary pricing profile expires 180 days after the effective date; standard rate card applies thereafter."
- Contract language: Greenfield accepts the temporary profile and requested a light clause — I've asked Legal to draft.

Let me know if this is sufficient for signoff. If helpful I can expose the usage model in the shared drive for Finance to run sensitivity.

Jonas

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenfield hosted API — proposal & ask for temporary slope

Jonas/Karthik — reviewed the numbers with Revenue Ops. Two asks before final approval:

1) Add a minimum monthly billing floor for months 1-6 equal to 80% of the expected billed spend per month in the spreadsheet. This protects against heavy under-delivery.
2) Add an automatic reporting cadence: weekly token usage export to a shared drive folder and an exception flag if actual billed tokens fall below 70% of forecast for two consecutive weeks.

If Greenfield accepts both items (we prefer to put them into the SOW), Revenue will approve a one-time slope exception up to 6 months. Laura — can Legal prepare the SOW language (temporary pricing clause, billing floor, reporting requirement)? Marissa — my expectation is this doesn't need VP escalation if Revenue approves.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aisha@greenfield.ai, procurement@greenfield.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenfield hosted API — proposal & ask for temporary slope

All — I reviewed the thread and the proposed guardrails. Approved with conditions:

- Temporary slope approval granted for up to 6 months with the billing floor and reporting cadence Laura specified.
- Legal to include explicit sunset language and the billing floor clause in the SOW; Revenue Ops to own weekly reporting and exception alerts; Customer success to monitor onboarding and ensure config freeze is enforced.
- Finance to be notified if cumulative billed tokens in months 1-3 are more than 25% below the model — at that point we'll escalate and potentially convert remaining committed spend to a reserved credit schedule.

Jonas — you can communicate the approval to Greenfield and attach the updated proposal; include the reporting folder link and outline the enforcement steps. Copy Legal when the SOW draft is ready.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
